text:
maria_ops: Heads up — vendor Zenith just flagged APAC H100 topoff. Allocation slipped ~4 weeks, they have 12 units in Pool A with partial-DOA flags. Need a call: air-expedite replacements or accept delayed sea replenishment? ETA diff ~18d (sea) vs ~5d (air). Air surcharge ~+15%. @lee_procure @sophia_sre

lee_procure: Can you get serials + AWB? How many confirmed DOA vs suspect? Also confirm vendor warranty/turnaround on replacements.

vendor-zenith-bot: Zenith update: 12 units flagged; 4 confirmed DOA on arrival (serials: H100-0843, H100-0844, H100-0850, H100-0856). Full manifest pending. Air quote: expedite surcharge = 15% of unit price. Sea ETA = 18 days, Air ETA = 5 days. Proforma AWB (sample): 1Z12345ZEN.

sophia_sre: If we air-expedite, which DCs get them? APAC1 preferred but NRT customs backlog is bad atm. Can we route to SIN depot? Also we need KDM/import docs for depot repair flow.

jonathan_logistics: We can route to SIN depot to avoid NRT backlog, but forwarder needs HS code confirmation (8471.80). Insurance/claims: vendor requires proof-of-failure photos + depot sign-off. RMA SLA from vendor: replacement processed within 7 days after arrival at depot.

lee_procure: Cost check: unit price $18,500. 12 units = $222,000. Air surcharge +15% = +$33,300. Customs/broker est ~$2,000. Vendor offers $1,500/unit credit for delay on sea (-$18,000). Net delta to expedite ~+$17,300 (+~8%). Thoughts?

maria_ops: :eyes: We need capacity for Q3 launch. Losing 12 units for 18 days hurts. Recommend split: air-expedite 8 critical units, sea for 4 noncritical. @jonathan_logistics can you confirm routing + proforma AWB when vendor finalizes?

jonathan_logistics: We can do split: 8 air -> SIN depot, 4 sea -> AMS pool. Will request proforma AWB + final manifest by EOD. Need vendor to confirm serials and provide DOA evidence (photos). Also flag any pre-paid customs/L/C requirements.

vendor-zenith-bot: Acknowledged. Will provide full manifest + photos by 15:00 UTC. Proforma air AWB 1Z12345ZEN will be sent. Note: expedited shipments require pre-cleared customs docs; vendor confirms payment terms unchanged.

sophia_sre: Quick ops note: we have a hot-spare pool of 6 H100s. If we air-expedite 8, we'll still have 6 spare while replacements arrive, but we should prioritize deployment to low-latency APAC customers. Ops: prep canary schedule and capacity gating.

maria_ops: Plan then — Lee: approve air surcharge up to $35k; Jon: confirm routing + docs; Vendor: send manifest/photos. I'll open an ops ticket for canary + gating. :thumbsup:

jonathan_logistics: On it. Will post AWB + final cost breakout here when I have them.
